title: Relic Swarm
game_overview: A relentless horde survival roguelite where players battle waves of monsters, auto-cast devastating spells, and sell weapons to refine their ultimate loadout.
winning_condition: Survive for 15 minutes and vanquish the final Abyssal Titan boss.

controls.input: W / A / S / D or Arrow Keys
controls.action: Move character in 8 directions across the arena.
Smooth directional movement with analog velocity.
Confirm selection in menus and level-up screens.
Toggle Inventory / Weapon Selling Sheet during gameplay.
Pause game and access options or loadout summary.
On-screen directional movement for mobile devices.
Tap to toggle weapon selling interface on mobile.

sections.title: Design Pillars
sections.content:
1. Fluid Horde Combat: Smooth 60 FPS swarm rendering with distinct hit feedback and satisfying crowd-clearing attacks.
2. Dynamic Build Flexibility: Players can sell underperforming weapons or passives on the fly to reclaim slots and refund gold for dynamic build pivoting.
3. Deep Meta-Progression: Extensive persistent skill tree upgrades, unlockable heroes, and selectable starting loadouts that reward repeated runs.
4. Universal Accessibility: Intuitive auto-firing with full support for Keyboard, Gamepad, and responsive Virtual Touch controls.
sections.summary: Core guiding principles of Relic Swarm.

sections.title: Core Loop
sections.content:
1. Choose Starter Loadout: Select an unlocked hero archetype and starting weapon (starting at Level 1).
2. Battle & Auto-Cast: Navigate an expansive arena, automatically firing weapons at approaching swarms.
3. Gather & Level Up: Collect XP gems from defeated foes to trigger 3-choice level-up drafts featuring weapons and passive relics.
4. Manage & Sell Arsenal: Open the inventory at will or during draft screens to sell equipped weapons/passives, refunding gold to free up slots for higher-synergy builds.
5. Defeat Elites & Bosses: Crack open treasure chests dropped by elite enemies for multi-item surges.
6. Meta-Progression: Spend extracted gold in the permanent Sanctum Shop on stat nodes (Max HP, Area %, Cooldown Reduction, Magnet, Greed) and unlock new heroes/weapons.

sections.title: Core Mechanics & Weapon Selling System
sections.content:
1. Auto-Firing Arsenal: Weapons trigger automated targeting cycles based on nearest enemy, highest health enemy, or directional sweeps. Max 4 Weapon slots and 4 Passive Relic slots.
2. Dynamic Weapon & Passive Selling: Players can open the inventory overlay (via Tab / I / Gamepad Y / Touch button) or click 'Sell' on equipped items during level-up screens. Selling refunds 70% of invested gold/XP value, instantly frees the slot, and adds sold items back into the draft pool for subsequent level-ups.
3. Starting Loadout Selection: In the character select menu, players select their unlocked Hero (e.g., Pyromancer, Spellblade, Void Stalker) with distinct baseline stats and their chosen Level 1 starting weapon.
4. Synergistic Evolutions: Max level weapons combine with specific passive relics when opening boss chests to create legendary Awakened Weapons (e.g., Spirit Blades + Might Talisman -> Phantom Storm).
sections.summary: Detailed breakdown of auto-combat, inventory management, and loadouts.

sections.title: Movement & Scrolling Alignment
sections.content: Scrolling Axis: Multi-Directional (Omnidirectional free-roaming arena). Asset Orientation Baseline: All character and enemy sprites face right (3 o'clock) by default; the engine flips horizontal orientation (scaleX = -1) when moving leftward. Player Controls: 8-way directional velocity with acceleration and deceleration dampening. Camera Behavior: Smooth camera interpolation (lerp) tracking the player character with soft bounds.
sections.summary: Free XY top-down arena movement mechanics.

sections.title: Visual Hierarchy & Layering
sections.content: Layer Separation: Arena floor tiles are rendered in desaturated, dark gothic tones with subtle grid markers. Playfield entities (player, projectiles, XP gems, enemy swarms) use high-contrast vibrant colors and luminous outlines to ensure instant readability amidst hundreds of mobs. Hazard Affordance: Elite enemies and boss telegraphs feature pulsing crimson warning auras. HUD Overlay: Sleek top-aligned XP bar, bottom-left HP/stats display, top-right survival timer and kill counter, and cleanly docked weapon slot indicators that do not obstruct the central action area.
sections.summary: Rules for playfield contrast, cues, and HUD.

sections.title: Characters & Enemies
sections.content:
Playable Heroes:
- Spellblade Eric: Balanced hero starting with Magic Missile and +10% Move Speed.
- Pyromancer Vanya: High damage caster starting with Flame Blast and +15% Area Size.
- Void Stalker Nyx: Agile rogue starting with Orbiting Daggers and +10% Cooldown Reduction.

Enemy Swarms:
- Skeleton Grunts: Basic swarming melee infantry with moderate speed.
- Abyssal Bats: Fast erratic flyers that dive in zig-zag formations.
- Shadow Hounds: High-speed pack hunters that flank the player.
- Void Sorcerers: Ranged casters that cast slow homing dark orbs.
- Abyssal Titan (Boss): Monolithic boss with sweeping laser beams, ground slams, and minion summoning.
sections.summary: Playable heroes and diverse enemy archetypes.

sections.title: Fairness Tools
sections.content:
1. XP Magnet Pulse: Leveling up or collecting rare magnet runes vacuums all on-screen XP gems toward the player.
2. Danger Proximity Indicators: Off-screen elite enemies and boss spawns display red directional chevron pointers.
3. Reroll & Banish: Meta-upgrades allow players to reroll level-up draft choices or banish unwanted items for the remainder of the run.
4. Invulnerability Frames: Brief 0.5s damage cooldown upon taking a hit with flashing white sprite feedback.
sections.summary: Player assistance and visual clarity systems.

sections.title: Juice & Game Feel
sections.content:
1. Anticipation Juice: Charging weapons display glowing particle gathering circles around the hero before release.
2. State Change Juice: Floating gold and XP numbers, dynamic chromatic aberration flash when leveling up, and vibrant pickup trails.
3. Impact Juice: Screen shake intensity calibrated to damage dealt, micro hit-stop freeze frames on boss critical hits, and satisfying multi-kill shatter particles.
sections.summary: Feedback across anticipation, state change, and impact.

sections.title: Meta-Progression & Persistent Upgrades
sections.content:
Players earn Gold throughout runs from enemy drops and chest bounties. In the Sanctum Meta-Shop:
- Max Health (+10% per rank, max 5 ranks)
- Might / Damage (+5% per rank, max 5 ranks)
- Movement Speed (+5% per rank, max 5 ranks)
- Cooldown Haste (+4% per rank, max 5 ranks)
- Pickup Radius (+15% per rank, max 5 ranks)
- Greed / Gold Gain (+10% per rank, max 5 ranks)
- Extra Rerolls & Skips (+1 per rank, max 3 ranks)
- Character & Weapon Unlocks achieved via in-game milestones (e.g., Survive 10 minutes, Defeat 1,000 enemies).

sections.title: Accessibility
sections.content: High-contrast visual mode for projectiles and health bars, adjustable screen shake intensity slider, auto-aim toggle option, and fully remappable keyboard and gamepad controls.

sections.title: Structural Integrity
sections.content: Flow: Main Menu -> Character & Loadout Selection -> Sanctum Meta-Shop -> Active Run -> Level-Up Overlays -> Inventory Sell Modal -> Victory / Game Over Summary -> Meta Rewards.

sections.title: Virtual Touch Controls Implementation
sections.content: Render an on-screen virtual analog joystick on the bottom-left of the screen and a floating Inventory / Sell button on the bottom-right. Buttons must use touch-none and pointer-events-auto on interactive elements only, and handle onPointerLeave, onPointerCancel, and onPointerUp events gracefully to eliminate stuck inputs.
